_authority: How much delivery redesign an existing module needs. retrofit/scripts/classify_module.py implements exactly these signals and thresholds.
_the_rule_that_matters: CLASSIFY ON DELIVERY QUALITY, NEVER ON WHETHER THE HTML WORKS. A module whose markup is valid, whose links resolve and whose checks pass can still be educationally and visually weak, and that module is a B or a C. 'It works' is not a reason to preserve it.
_do_not_ask: Decide this yourself from the signals. Ask the operator only if the module is genuinely ambiguous - not to make them own the decision.

A.name: preserve mostly as-is
A.means: the module is already on the canonical system and composed. Fix the named defects, leave the delivery alone.
A.typical: a module built by the current Factory that has drifted slightly

B.name: moderate delivery redesign
B.means: the system is present but the delivery is thin: composition is uniform, visuals are undersized or absent, activity screens are cards rather than screens.
B.typical: an earlier Factory module, or a careful hand-build that never had a visual system

C.name: substantial delivery redesign
C.means: the delivery implementation is not evidence of anything. Take the content and the learning intent; rebuild the delivery.
C.typical: a module predating the Factory - default HTML, a wall of text, no shell, no composition, no tablet behaviour

signals._note: Each returns a score 0..1 where 1 is 'already at product quality'. Absent data scores 0 - a module with no shell has no shell, and that is a finding, not a missing measurement.

canonical_shell.asks: does it load gb_tokens + gb_shell (+ gb_compose) and use #stage/.slide/#btnNext?

composition_vocabulary.asks: what share of screens declare a named composition on .slide-body, and how many DISTINCT ones does the module use?
composition_vocabulary.note: a module where every screen is default flow scores 0 here even if each screen is tidy - uniformity is the defect

teaching_visuals.asks: what share of substantial teaching screens carry a figure, photograph, schematic or interactive component rather than text alone?

activity_screens.asks: are activity launches whole screens using the canonical treatment, or cards inside an ordinary screen?

tablet_behaviour.asks: touch navigation present, back hook present, tap targets at the floor, no links inside slides

token_adherence.asks: does it paint from the canonical tokens rather than its own dialect?

overrides.why: there is nothing to preserve at the delivery layer

overrides.if: every screen is default flow AND teaching_visuals < 0.25
overrides.why: a uniform text module is the case this whole law exists for
the one-page architecture is broken, which is a delivery rebuild however good the rest looks

not_signals._rule: These must never move the classification.
items: the file is large, or recent, or was hand-written with care
somebody would be disappointed if it changed
